name: AI2050 语言编码机制全局结构辨识
north_star: 识别能够以低描述长度预测未知世界、未知干预、多步生成、组合与跨模型响应的功能状态及其转移结构。
current_bottleneck: Phase1263/C013 changed the estimand from hidden generator identity to a reference-risk predictive functional quotient and separated independent donor rescue from algebraic replay. Exact class recovery was 318/320 and abstention 82/84: two equivalence-overlap systems straddled the frozen 0.050 risk boundary across reference panels but fell just below it on selection. All applicable response, independent rescue, wrong-identity, control and leakage-sentinel gates passed. The bottleneck is finite-sample certification of boundary abstention, not candidate capacity.
next_decision: C013 is closed before free-network execution. Do not delete the two overlap systems, widen the pass threshold, rerun seeds, or treat the successful algebraic replay sentinel as mediation. Any future campaign must preregister a finite-sample stability certificate or interval-valued quotient and prove it on fresh margin/boundary systems before external validity.
theory_status: 条件化输出场闭合理论与 RDC 术语保持不变。C013 supports predictive functional equivalence as the correct estimand and independently sourced donor rescue as a valid known-truth subobject, while showing that point-threshold abstention is unstable for risk-boundary systems. Functional state should be typed by a risk-qualified quotient with an explicit unresolved boundary region. Existing linear algebra, conditional dynamics, intervention, quotient and elementary error-bound language remain sufficient; no new foundational mathematics is authorized.
migration_note: WP00 已登记 GPT/GLM docs 的 22 个基线 Git blob 快照，并追加 Phase1236 工程闭合快照；关键科学证据仍只迁移 Phase1210–1235 子集，不声称替代 K1–K210 总账。
